'''Drone fighters''' were [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] used by [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Bisad Koong|Koong's]] [[Tawntoom]] province of [[Roon/Legends|Roon]] during the early years of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. They were [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] by a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] and could be launched from Koong's galley, the ''[[Roon Clipper]]''.
